fields.statement: Verified at 0afdeea5. cmd/rhiza/testdata/script/daemon-install.txtar puts fake systemctl and loginctl on PATH. It checks that install writes $HOME/.config/systemd/user/rhiza-repo.service with ExecStart=<rhiza> daemon, WorkingDirectory set to the main checkout (also when run from a worktree), Restart=always and After=rex.service. It checks the calls in order: systemctl --user daemon-reload, systemctl --user enable --now rhiza-repo.service, loginctl enable-linger. A second install leaves the file byte-identical and does no daemon-reload. Uninstall calls systemctl --user disable --now and daemon-reload and removes the file. With PATH holding only the test's rhiza dir (RHIZA_TEST_BIN), both commands exit 2 with 'needs systemd: systemctl is not on PATH' and write nothing. Read internal/api/daemon_service.go: it matches the test, and a unit not written by install is never overwritten or removed. Attempt-1 finding f1 (the test inherited the host PATH) is fixed. With logging fake systemctl/loginctl prepended to the host PATH, go test ./cmd/rhiza -run TestScripts/daemon-install -count=1 passed and the host fakes were never run. In a clean clone at the commit, go test ./... passed (an earlier make test run failed only on the read-timing budget test, which does not touch this leaf), and make fmt-check vet self-check passed.
